You have a core mental health team located in the building of the surgery. Let’s not act clueless and pretend you didn’t know that and within there it has the unhelpful employee I named.

I believe the practice manager should urgently review the conduct of the Nigerian mental health assistant, Joyce. In my experience, she shows very little care or concern for patients. Her manner is dismissive and unhelpful, which is deeply concerning given the vulnerable individuals she is meant to support.

I attend Alcoholics Anonymous meetings, and a number of people in Camden have unfortunately reported similar experiences with her. It appears that this is not an isolated issue, but something affecting multiple patients.

Mental health services require compassion, patience, and professionalism. When staff appear indifferent to patients who are already struggling, it can discourage people from seeking help and undermine trust in the service. recently visited Camden Health Improvement Practice and was incredibly impressed by the outstanding service I received. From the moment I arrived, the friendly receptionists Sumayah and Ali made me feel welcome and comfortable.

Nurse Abi did an exceptional job conducting a variety of tests, including blood and urine tests. Her professionalism and thoroughness were evident throughout the process. I have been to different GPs before, but this practice truly stands out in many ways.

In just two hours, I registered, completed multiple tests, and had the opportunity to see Dr. Nauta, who was caring, patient, and highly professional. Her approach made me feel well-cared for and informed about my health.

I was also fortunate to meet the manager, Paul, before leaving. His leadership clearly contributes to the outstanding service provided by the entire team.

Overall, my experience at Camden Health Improvement Practice was exceptional. The efficiency, care, and professionalism of the staff are unparalleled.
